description: E5 paper baseline (Fig. 7, p14; Sec. V B, p13): translation-invariant classical HMM trained by Baum-Welch on spect_heart (n=23, M=2), same split as the _original config. EM iteration cap and tolerance are not stated in the paper (R3): 2000 iterations or relative NLL change <= 1e-8 (cap fixed in Phase 3 from a convergence check at h=12: changes beyond 2000 iterations <= 6e-4 bits/site). Sweep --bond-dim 1..12 and --seed 0..9.
